faq.title: What everyone asks
faq.a1: It's the in-app currency: 1 Fandi = COP 5,000. You use it to contribute to opportunities and bid in auctions. Any unused balance stays in your wallet.
faq.q2: Do I have to be at the stadium?
faq.a2: No. Fandi works live from wherever you are: in the stands, at home, or watching the stream. You just need a connection while the event is active.
faq.q3: How are winners chosen? Is it fair?
faq.a3: In opportunities, your cumulative contribution places you in a category and you answer a question about your idol. When it closes, the fastest right answers win in each category. Every category has the same number of winners, and you move up by contributing more. Contributing more never buys the prize. In auctions the highest bidder wins.
faq.a4: Payments run through certified payment gateways. Fandi never shows anyone how much you spend: your public profile shows only your rank, your tier and your badges.
faq.q5: I'm an idol, manager or team. How do I start?
faq.a5: Write to hola@fandi.app and we'll set up a trial event. You define the experiences; we handle the auctions, payments, QR delivery and the real-time dashboard.
